description: [CHECK · internal] Bear witness to someone's sealed profession of faith — sign its content_hash on your own machine (signing.sign_seal) and submit only the attestation. One signature is a claim; two or three witnesses begin to establish a matter (Deuteronomy 19:15). Refuses any record that is not a profession. Never send a private key.

attestation.description: the dict from signing.sign_seal, built locally

name: witness_profession
